verdict.rationale: Vercel documents built-in Web Analytics and function/traffic/error monitoring ('Monitor traffic, function performance, and errors with framework-aware insights') plus an MCP tool 'get_web_analytics' that queries visitors, page views, and custom events, alongside runtime logs/errors and an in-browser toolbar for inspecting performance. This directly covers site performance and visitor behavior tracking natively on the platform. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of analytics accuracy or dashboard usability, and detail on data retention/export limits.
